items.title: Her Mom Beat AI Fear in 20 Minutes
items.summary: In episode 1023 of the SuperDataScience Podcast, Jon Krohn talks with Aishwarya Srinivasan, Co-Founder of The Gen Academy about the 'Mindful Use' and 'Integration' components of her MIND framework, illustrating how her mom overcame AI intimidation to use ChatGPT's camera feature. Aishwarya emphasizes that AI tools are neither magical nor detrimental, but rather powerful tools whose impact depends on how mindfully they are used and integrated into daily life. She shares a personal anecdote about teaching her mom to use ChatGPT's camera, highlighting how simple guidance can bridge the intimidation gap.

items.title: HUGE: India's Defense Exports Jumped 62 Percent and Aero India 2027 Will Prove If It Was Real
items.summary:
Aero India 2027 is set to showcase India's progress in military aviation and domestic defense manufacturing capabilities.

The government, led by Prime Minister Modi, has pushed for Atmanirbhar Bharat, resulting in significant milestones for the defense sector. The upcoming event at Air Force Station Yalahanka will highlight how the nation has scaled production to 1.78 lakh crore rupees. This expansion now includes 500 licensed companies and nearly 17,000 MSMEs working to strengthen the domestic supply chain.

Beyond domestic production, the focus is shifting toward global export targets. By 2029, the goal is to reach 3 lakh crore rupees in production and 50,000 crore rupees in exports. This transition tests whether the country can effectively market its advanced military technology to international militaries.

items.title: India’s $200 BILLION Data Centre Boom! #Shorts
items.summary:
Piyush Goyal says India’s data-centre industry could see at least $200 billion in investment, with hyperscalers and global investors suggesting the potential could be even higher.

Speaking after a roundtable with data-centre industry stakeholders, the Union Commerce and Industry Minister said the government discussed ways to further improve ease of doing business and attract more data-centre investments. He also pointed to India’s 7.8% growth in the April-June 2026 quarter and said data centres, semiconductors, AI and manufacturing will support the country’s growth ambitions.

Goyal said the government wants to develop India into “the data centre of the world”, citing strong domestic demand, international interest and industry capabilities.

items.title: BREAKING: Assam Is Building Its Own Satellite and 13 Indian Space Companies Want to Make It
items.summary:
Assam is launching its own Earth observation satellite system, marking a major shift in India news and regional governance.

The Assam State Space Application Center has officially shortlisted 13 companies, including Tata Advanced Systems and Pixxel, to build the Assam SAT system. This project moves the state from buying satellite data to owning its own space-based assets. By adopting a Design, Build, Launch, Operate, Train, and Transfer model, the state aims to gain internal expertise to manage floods, infrastructure, and land monitoring effectively.

This initiative highlights the rapid growth of the private space sector in the country, which has seen significant funding recently. As Assam takes this step, it could provide a replicable model for other regions looking to advance their own space exploration capabilities through targeted public-private partnerships.

items.title: EXPOSED: New York City Says AI Does Not Belong in Primary School and Is Banning It for a Year
items.summary:
NYC public schools are implementing a one-year moratorium on generative AI for students in grades 2k through 8th.

This policy change affects nearly 600,000 students across the district as the city restricts the use of student-facing tools. We examine how the new rules impact the classroom environment and why officials decided to disable 38 EdTech AI tools for the 2026-27 academic year. By reviewing these specific restrictions, you will understand the current stance on technology in public education and what it means for young learners.

Companion chatbots are specifically prohibited under this new mandate, marking a significant shift in how artificial intelligence is integrated into the curriculum. We break down the scope of this ban and what parents and educators need to know about the upcoming school year adjustments.
